item.title: One way to protect coral reefs? Bring back seabirds
item.description: Coral reefs are facing increasing threats around the globe. But on a remote Pacific island, scientists have found that reefs can get help from a surprising ally: seabirds.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
item.description: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

item.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
item.description: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
item.description: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home
item.description: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C. home of Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., Monday morning. Omar criticized the search, calling it a weaponization of federal law enforcement.

item.title: Texans share how rising beef prices are affecting them this election season
item.description: The cost of living is one of the biggest issues in the upcoming midterm elections. NPR's A Martínez explores one slice of the economy in the key state of Texas: beef prices.

item.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
item.description: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

item.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
item.description: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.
